changes.summary: Automation built-in nodes, review follow-up (#1417): an Action whose command the workflow sends again after a lost dispatch keeps the call's deadline and holds a call slot (NativeRun.CallDispatches); the http node sends a CEL string of a json body as a JSON string and only a rendered {{ }} template as JSON text (graph.Effect.Templated, catalog.CallInput.Templated); the guarded fetcher caps response headers at 64 KiB (WithMaxHeaderBytes, ErrResponseHeadersTooLarge) and the http node's output budget counts them; NUL normalization (pkg/jsonb) never merges two keys, and the workflow's occurrence errors, failed and blocked details, a call's error code and unknown-outcome message and an SDK action's invalid_args message are written with U+FFFD; run_automation finds every waiting ancestor of a conversation down to Limits.MaxDepth instead of 64 levels.

Automations editor: a version navigation aborts the request of the one it replaces, Back or Forward to the version on screen loads nothing and keeps the draft, a confirmed switch makes the editor read only (Undo and Redo included) until the version arrives, and a declined Back or Forward returns to the entry it left instead of adding one.

MCP connector review follow-up (#1422): templates of a tool call are read against the branch the other templates' readings choose, whatever the order of their names; the save-time argument check follows if/then/else, anyOf, oneOf and not along the whole failure path ($ref into $defs included) and judges a branch whose choice reads only literals; a tools/list is cached per the token that read it, so a new OAuth sign-in never gets the previous user's catalog or readOnlyHint; BeginAuthorization re-checks the server under the row lock and discovers again when it changed. The automations module now gives its engine the connector directory, so only x-secret credential fields are masked in call output and errors (an MCP output that echoes the server URL or auth kind stays as its schema checked it).

Wire the automation MCP operations into the application: pkg/mcp/mcpwiring is the MCP composition (on when the application passes its mcp.Registry with an Authorizer, a ConfirmingAuditor and ApprovalURL; no *_ENABLED flag) that registers the tools modules contribute (ContributeTools) and the guarded-changes service over the contributed kinds (ContributeKinds) with changes.Config.Auditor, and calls DispatchEffects periodically in API/worker processes. The automations module contributes mcpops.Tools and mcpops.Kinds with its pages under http.origin and sets engine.Config.Links to the editor's run pages by default. Adds a READ COMMITTED regression test for engine ListVersions.
Index the foreign keys of automation.oauth_states (user_id, connection_id) and automation.connection_requests (connection_id) so deleting a user or a connection no longer scans them.

Automations: modules/automations provides its engine as engine.RunStarter whenever the composition runs the engine, so start_automation and run_automation start child graphs in an assembled application (before, they always failed with runs_unavailable). The end node takes output (name → CEL), which becomes the run's output and what run_automation reads as nodes.<id>.output.output; a graph version may declare output_schema (JSON Schema of type object), checked against every end node on save (required names, closed schemas, CEL types) and against the computed values when the run ends (INVALID_OUTPUT). An end without output keeps giving its params, as before.

Automations: a built-in Secret connector on the Integrations page (create, rename, rotate, delete; values behind an OpenBao-ready storage port, the first adapter the connections' encrypted store) resolved by Code and HTTP nodes before the application's resolver, with Secrets.Manage / Secrets.Use permissions; CodeAccessor for the SDK connectors — HTTP/API (base URL and a fetch with injected auth), Telegram bot, Email (SMTP) and AI/LLM — with typed refusals for disabled or broken connections. Upgrade note: Code and HTTP nodes now use connections only for a run-as subject holding Connections.Use (permission set connections_use); an application that registered its own CodeAccessor connector (WithConnectors) grants it to the roles its automations run as.

Automation secrets: rotations write only under a swept locator root, cleanup has one budget bounded by the caller, store writes are bounded by the write window, and the integrations page offers no «Add secret» or rotation without an encryption key.

Automation graph memory between runs: the automation.state table (tenant, automation, key, JSON value up to 16 KiB, optional expiry; at most 10,000 live keys per automation, expired keys swept in the background), the built-in set_state node (key template, CEL value, ttl 1m–365d or delete; outcomes set and failed with codes state_value_too_large, state_value_invalid, state_key_invalid, state_limit_exceeded, state_ttl_invalid; written in the step's transaction; captured by a dry run), state.get(key) / state.has(key) in the CEL of a step (lazy lookup, map get/has member functions; dry run reads the saved graph's memory and never writes), engine Memory API and MCP operations (automation_state_list/get tools, automation.state.set/delete changes, mcpops.WithMemory), automations.state_list/state_set/state_delete RPC and a memory panel in the graph settings of the editor (settingsSlot). Fixes mcpops after the Authoring.Validate signature change.

Automations: «My tasks» inbox at /automations/tasks — human-node tasks assigned to the user, their roles, groups or permissions or delegated to them (tasks.TaskInbox over the human tasks substrate, visible to the current audience only), decided with the node's outcome buttons, comment and typed schema fields, delegated to a colleague, with overdue and decided-by-me tabs and a navigation counter (application.NavNode.Badge); HUMAN_REQUIRED (403 with code) for agents. TaskForm extension point (tasks.ContributeTaskForm, `x-iota-form` annotation validated on save, never run past the final deadline); the module registers the human node, its task bridge and observer, the native entity automation.task and event automation.task.assigned.v1 (automations.Natives) and its notification to the assignees, checked at delivery by the rule of automation.task (notifications.ContributeSubjectAccess). Record names for subjects (pkg/automation/subjects; core.user and crm.client contributed). workflow.Engine.TasksByID and Task.PastFinalDeadline. Route auth policies honor the pattern of a route variable ({id:<regex>}), so a literal sibling route keeps its own policy.

Automation: модуль automations сам регистрирует коннектор telegram_bot (APP_TELEGRAMBOTTOKEN как платформенный бот, origin приложения, inbound движка, вложения в загрузках; WithoutTelegram убирает), и он появляется в каталоге. Вложения из чатов Telegram приватные, как у Email: .private/automations-telegram/<tenant>, ссылка — /automations/attachments/{id} (вход, тот же тенант, Automations.Read, скачивание с sandbox); uploads.NewTelegramUploads принимает privateRoot, Open не читает приватные файлы других функций; services.AttachmentServable, AttachmentPath, PrivateAttachments. Резерв платформенного бота — lease (connectors.PlatformLease, колонка exclusive_identities.lease_until), его продлевает каждый экземпляр с этим credential: при rolling-обновлении прежний бот остаётся зарезервирован, пока работают старые экземпляры; старт (резерв и setWebhook) идёт под advisory-lock аккаунта (connectors.StartPlatformIdentity, PrunePlatformIdentities). Редактор графов: RPC automations.search_options и EditorApi.searchOptions в хосте — выбор чата из известных чатов подключения. Выведенный платформенный бот отклоняется (тест). Резерв с действующим lease база не даёт удалить (совместимость с предыдущей версией при выкатке); снятые платформенные аккаунты записываются в automation.retired_platform_identities, и запоздавший platform setWebhook на боте тенанта сам возвращается на подключение (engine.PlatformStrayReceiver, поиск по индексу хеша секрета). Первое обновление до этой версии при настроенном платформенном боте Telegram — только без перекрытия версий (recreate), токен и origin в той же выкатке не менять; смена origin — с явным переносом webhook (deleteWebhook, затем выкатка, проверка getWebhookInfo) — см. docs/automation-telegram.md.

Automations task inbox: review fixes from #1413 — retry notification checks on transient errors, validate a task form's submission and its final deadline before the form acts, keep permission grants and tasks usable when role or subject lookups fail, count quorum progress by agreeing votes, page the inbox stably across escalations (human_task_escalations.due_before), read a task and its decisions in one snapshot, keep sidebar folders holding ForEveryone items, safer decision form (danger confirmation, optional booleans, exact numbers, JSON fallback), and pt-BR/zh translations.

Finance: payment updates now save the payment category (including clearing it) and refuse a category of another tenant, expense updates bump updated_at, and payment and expense updates and deletes are scoped to the current tenant.
Document Plot-managed SDK merges and on-demand releases.
Make sdkctl promote wait for an externally triggered SDK release and apply it locally with read-only GitHub access.

Notification channels become an open registry (notifications.ChannelRegistry, ChannelSpec, ContributeChannel; Channel.Valid is a format check and the channel CHECK of core.notification_deliveries and core.notification_channel_preferences becomes ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,31}$), with opt-in channels, per-tenant channel connections (core.notification_channel_connections, picked on /settings/notifications) and user channel links through one-use deep link tokens (ChannelLinkService, core.notification_channel_links). The Telegram channel (modules/core/notifications/telegramchannel) sends to the private chat a user linked with /start u_<token> and is contributed by the automations module whenever its directory has the Telegram connector (on by default; automations.WithoutTelegram leaves both out); the profile gets a «Notifications» section with channel switches, Telegram linking and a test notification. NotificationChannelService.Available and Validate and NotificationRoutingService.Channels now take a context (the tenant's channels); a delivery on a channel the tenant lost is skipped with channel_not_configured.
